horseshoe-beach.character: A working Gulf fishing village of stilt homes, canals and boat basins, rather than a sandy beach.

manual_fixes: Town palette and waterfront hero curated from regional visitor references; facade color is editorial, not surveyed.
Published prices retain their actual metric and period; thin markets are explicitly labeled.
